summary: argo-migrate's flip and autosync now edit ArgoCDDeploy releases/values.yaml, keeping its comments. Each edit is re-parsed, checked with helm lint, and committed locally. Every on-Argo, upstream-pin and syncOptions read goes to the registry. stuck_fields.py moved to support/argo-migrate/, and the tool's preflight and the argocd runbook run it from there. The proof was on a scratch clone, and root's gate now runs the new registry-edit unit tests (Ansible b56fc9a; plan and close-out S16/S17 in AnsibleSpecs 7641780).
